title: Ilizwi Lobulumko Ezithunzini
intro: Umntu wamandulo, owaziwa ngokuqonda okunzulu, uthetha nawe kwiinkulungwane ezininzi. Lo mntu akazange azibize ngokuba ngumprofeti, kodwa ubulumko bukaThixo babuphuma emazwini akhe. Njengomzali oshiye ilifa elingunaphakade lesikhokelo, iingcebiso zakhe zisagcinwe ezintliziyweni zezigidi zabantu, ziphindaphindwa kwaye zicamngcwa nanamhlanje.
clues: Ndafumana isipho esivela kuThixo esandenza ndahluka - ubulumko obunzulu kangangokuba baba luphawu lwam oluphambili kwimbali.
Bendingengomthunywa okanye ingelosi - bendingumphefumlo osikelelwe ngokuqonda okunzulu kunye nokuqonda ihlabathi.
Ulwalamano lwam olusondeleyo lwaluphakathi komntwana wam, kwaye ngalo lwalamano, umyalezo wam ohlala uhleli wadluliselwa.
Ndacela umbulelo kuLowo undinike yonke into, ndaza ndalumkisa nxamnye nekratshi nokuzikhukhumeza.
Ndifundise ngobunzima bezenzo ezixabisa nokuba yimbewu yemostade, kunye nokubaluleka kokunciphisa ilizwi lakho ngokuthobeka.
Isahluko kwiQuran sinegama lam, apho icebiso lam kunyana wam othandekayo ligcinwe khona ngonaphakade.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
